mechanism.claim: When the BTC perpetual makes an extreme normalized intrabar excursion beyond the simultaneous BTC spot excursion but closes no farther than spot in that direction, leverage-only price discovery has been rejected by the cash market. During elevated BTC variation, fade the rejected perpetual-only wick for eight hours.
mechanism.side: short an upper leverage-only rejection; long a lower leverage-only rejection
mechanism.why_distinct: Premium-index wick rejection studies the synthetic premium candle itself. Spot displacement, basis, error-correction, flow leadership, and first-passage candidates use closes, basis states, flow, or ordered barrier times. HVLOWR instead compares simultaneous normalized high/open and open/low excursions of the actual spot and perpetual markets, then requires close-level cash nonconfirmation. It uses no fitted outcome, OI, funding, volume, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing perpetual 24-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular cross-market high/low excursion divergence onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact UTC five-minute boundary D
features.market_bars: five exact coherent native one-minute bars [D-5m,D) for BTCUSDT perpetual and spot
features.normalized_upper_excursion: log(five-minute high/five-minute open) separately for perpetual and spot
features.normalized_lower_excursion: log(five-minute open/five-minute low) separately for perpetual and spot
features.upper_excess: perpetual upper excursion minus spot upper excursion
features.lower_excess: perpetual lower excursion minus spot lower excursion
features.excess_ranks: separate strict-prior midranks of upper_excess and lower_excess over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded
features.upper_rejection: upper_excess rank>=0.995 and perpetual log(close/open)<=spot log(close/open)
features.lower_rejection: lower_excess rank>=0.995 and perpetual log(close/open)>=spot log(close/open)
features.direction: exactly one rejection side; simultaneous upper and lower rejection is ineligible
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact perpetual one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: directional rejection true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid five-minute decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after both completed bars and causal ranks are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cash-nonconfirmation of leveraged intrabar excursion mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no market, bar, normalization, rank history, rank threshold, close confirmation, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
